+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""The tool-call output SSE must not be buffered by reverse proxies."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from fastapi import FastAPI
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from qwenpaw.app.routers.tool_calls import router
+
+
+class _Stream:
+    async def subscribe(self):
+        if False:  # pragma: no cover - empty async generator
+            yield None
+
+
+def test_tool_call_stream_disables_proxy_buffering() -> None:
+    entry = SimpleNamespace(
+        ctx=SimpleNamespace(session_id="s1"),
+        stream=_Stream(),
+    )
+    coordinator = SimpleNamespace(get=lambda _tool_call_id: entry)
+    app = FastAPI()
+    app.state.app_services = SimpleNamespace(tool_coordinator=coordinator)
+    app.include_router(router)
+
+    response = TestClient(app).get("/tool-calls/s1/tc1/stream")
+
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/event-stream")
+    assert response.headers["x-accel-buffering"] == "no"

+def test_chat_stream_disables_proxy_buffering() -> None:
+    class StreamContext:
+        app_id = "fixture"
+
+        def is_app_session_id(self, session_id: str) -> bool:
+            return session_id.startswith("pawapp:fixture")
+
+        async def ensure_chat_session(self, _session_id):
+            return None
+
+        async def chat_stream(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
+            yield {"type": "done"}
+
+    fixture = FastAPI()
+    fixture.include_router(_build_capability_router())
+    fixture.dependency_overrides[get_scoped_ctx] = StreamContext
+    client = TestClient(fixture)
+
+    response = client.post(
+        "/chat/stream",
+        json={"message": "hi", "session_id": "pawapp:fixture"},
+    )
+
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/event-stream")
+    assert response.headers["x-accel-buffering"] == "no"
